title: Paris Exposition, view from ground level of the Eiffel tower with Parisians promenading
notes: This record contains unverified data from old caption card.
Published in: "The World and Its Cultures" chapter of the ebook Great Photographs from the Library of Congress, 2013.
license: No known restrictions on reproduction (Library of Congress rights advisory on the item record)
institution: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division, Tissandier collection
note: Record date '[between 1887 and 1889]' (unverified caption-card data). Content shows the completed tower with the Exposition's Central Dome and Coutan fountain and crowds, i.e. during the Exposition Universelle (opened 6 May 1889).
